incidents.title: Water Service Advisory – Cow Bay Road
incidents.summary: Water Service Advisory – Cow Bay Road Published: 10:06 AM | September 11, 2026 Due to third-party construction work, Halifax Water crews have temporarily shut down water service near 519 Cow Bay Road, Eastern Passage, to facilitate emergency repairs. This work is taking place within an existing construction zone. Please follow all existing safety signage. Customers in the area may experience discoloured water during/following this repair. incidents.title: Traffic Advisory – Herring Cove Road
incidents.summary: Traffic Advisory – Herring Cove Road Published: 9:56 AM | September 11, 2026 Halifax Water crews are on-site undertaking an emergency water valve repair near 160 Herring Cove Road, Halifax. This will not impact Halifax Water services in the area. There will be an altered centre line in the work zone. Experienced traffic control personnel will be on-site to manage traffic flows. Sidewalks will remain open. Motorists should expect delays and use alternate routes. Motorists are also reminded that speed fines double in work zones. Read more Halifax Water
